title: WebServer and CORS
body:
I was trying to build a custom module for Cobi.bike (https://cobi.bike/devkit) to display XDrip data
using the webServer interface of XDrip. However Cobi's browser prohibits fetching of the data from
Xdrip's server because of CORS. Would it be possible to add "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *" to the header of the response from the server so that JS running on a browser would also be able to fetch the data?

comments.body: I'm now having an issue showing data on my fitbit... Getting CORS issue as well.
